headline: Oil hits $100; the US–Iran ceasefire wobbles
summary: WTI oil has now reached $100 (that market is at 100%), and traders are pushing toward $105. The US–Iran ceasefire lost 4–6 pts across every date, Canada's central bank is now expected to raise rates, and Russia–Ukraine talk odds bounced. Large traders put about $154k on the Fed holding next week.

takeaways.text: The 'WTI hits $100 in October' market is now at 100%. $105 jumped 18 pts in a day to 57.5% (up 41 this week), and $110 is 24.5% (up 8). Oil finishing the month below $90 collapsed to 17% (down 65 this week). An all-time high is still unlikely (22.5% by March).

Odds fell 4–6 pts across every date: through Oct 31 is 78.5% (down 4), and through Nov 8 is 66.5% (down 6). One trader sold $19k of 'holds through Oct 22'. The Israel–Iran ceasefire through Dec 31 slipped to 45% (down 11 this week).

takeaways.lead: Canada is about to raise rates (thin, but a big swing).
takeaways.text: A Bank of Canada hike at this month's meeting jumped 15 pts to 52% (up 37 this week; thin $320k market). A Canadian hike in 2026 is now 84.5% (up 28 in a day). Oil-driven inflation is spreading to other central banks.

takeaways.lead: $154k bet that the Fed holds next week.
takeaways.text: Three large orders ($72k, $65k, $17k) went on no change at the Oct 29 Fed meeting (now 85.5%). Another $45k went on a hike (14.5%, up 3). December is still 77.5% for a hike.
Russia–Ukraine peace talks by Nov 30 rose 9 pts to 28.5%, and by Dec 31 rose 6 to 38%. That's after a 25-pt drop last week, so treat it as a partial rebound, not a breakthrough.

takeaways.lead: AI money: OpenAI is up, Anthropic is down in the IPO race.
takeaways.text: OpenAI reaching a $1.25T valuation by year-end jumped 19 pts to 83%. Anthropic as 2026's biggest IPO fell 8 pts to 25% as SpaceX rose to 70.5%. Anthropic's next model (Fable 5.2) by Oct 24 fell 28 pts to 43%, though by Oct 31 is still 75% (thin market).

sections.title: What's new today
bullets: The France unrest markets are getting more money: a state of emergency by year-end is 17.5% ($137k now), and martial law is 4% ($199k). Still low odds, but growing interest.
Trump meeting Kim Jong Un in 2026 fell 13 pts to 13.5%.
A Tesla–SpaceX merger announced by year-end fell 11 pts to 15.5%.

sections.title: Trading signals
bullets: Oil: WTI $100 has been hit; $105 57.5%, $110 24.5%. Energy stocks win; airlines, trucking and consumers pay more.
Rates: no change from the Fed in October (85.5%), a hike in December (77.5%). Canada likely hikes this month (52%).
The SpaceX IPO is the favorite for the year's biggest listing (70.5%, up 24 this week).
About $26k of large bets said Texas and Indiana won't ban new data centers this year, so that political risk is fading in the near term.

sections.title: Wars & geopolitics
bullets: US–Iran ceasefire through Oct 31: 78.5% (down 4); Israel–Iran through Dec 31: 45% (down 4 today).
The blockade ending by year-end is 36.4% (down 3). Hormuz traffic back to normal by year-end: 12.5%. A $12k bet went on 'not normal'.
A Saudi–Houthi ceasefire by year-end is back up 7 pts to 30.5% (thin market).

sections.title: Elections that move markets
bullets: Brazil (Sunday, Oct 25): Bolsonaro 76.6%, Lula 22.5%. About $50k more of large bets went on Bolsonaro.
Israel (Oct 27): Eizenkot 50%, Netanyahu 29.5%. Yashar winning the most seats is 72.5% (up 5), with a $23k bet on it.
US midterms (Nov 3): about $89k of large bets went on Democrats controlling the House (about 91%). Three bets of about $14k each went on 'Republican Senate, Democratic House' (28%).

sections.title: Everyday life
bullets: Gas: oil has crossed $100, so expect pump prices to keep climbing over the next 1–2 weeks.
Canada: a rate hike this month is now slightly more likely than not, so variable mortgages there would cost more.
US borrowing: a December Fed hike is 77.5% likely, so don't count on cheaper loans this year.
